description: This is a PHP unit test file for the EmployeeEventDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It contains test cases verifying the saving and retrieval of employee event data, setting up mock data and asserting correct behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeEventDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the EmployeeEventDao methods for saving and retrieving employee events.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeEventDao instance and populates test data from fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeEvent entity and verifies the properties and persistence.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Tests fetching employee events based on search filter parameters and validates the response count.
